faq.title: Questions Bulgarian clients usually ask before booking.

travel.question: Do you travel outside one city?
travel.answer: Yes. Parkov accepts projects across Bulgaria. Travel costs can be included in the final quote depending on the location.

delivery.question: How fast are photos delivered?
delivery.answer: Delivery depends on the type and scale of the shoot. The expected timing for previews and the full edited gallery is confirmed with the booking.

deposit.question: Is a deposit required?
deposit.answer: For larger events, a deposit is usually recommended to reserve the date. We will confirm the exact policy with Parkov.

raw.question: Are RAW files included?
raw.answer: Usually clients receive edited final images. RAW delivery can be handled as a separate policy if the owner wants it.

languages.question: Can clients use Bulgarian or English?
languages.answer: Yes. The site supports both languages, with Bulgarian as the default and English available for international clients.

contact.title: Tell us what you want photographed.
contact.copy: The form is built for serious inquiries, while quick actions stay available for phone, Viber, WhatsApp, and email.
contact.location: Based in Bulgaria. Travel available depending on the project.

reply.subject: Your Parkov photography inquiry: {service}

availability.label: Available
availability.body:
Hello {name},

Thank you for contacting Parkov Photography about {service}. I am available around {date}. Please reply with any remaining details and I will confirm the next steps.

Best regards,
Parkov Photography

moreInformation.label: Ask for more details
moreInformation.body:
Hello {name},

Thank you for your inquiry about {service}. Before I confirm availability, could you share the expected start time, exact location, duration, and any specific photography requirements?

Best regards,
Parkov Photography

quotation.label: Send quotation
quotation.body:
Hello {name},

Thank you for the details about {service}. I can prepare a quotation for {date}. Please confirm the final timing, location, and scope so I can send the exact offer.

Best regards,
Parkov Photography

unavailable.label: Date unavailable

Hello {name},

Thank you for considering Parkov Photography for {service}. Unfortunately, I am not available on {date}. If your timing is flexible, reply with alternative dates and I will gladly check them.

Best regards,
Parkov Photography

Parkov Photography
